segments.name: Interior design and fit out service
segments.description: Provides interior design and fit out services for residential and non-residential premises in Hong Kong.
segments.evidence: The Company has identified the following two major reportable segments: ● Interior design and fit out service ● Robotics and AI Solutions Business

segments.name: Robotics and AI Solutions Business
segments.description: Develops and sells robotics and AI solutions, including robotic products, through a joint venture with Axonex Intelligence Limited.
